an3.120:1.5: idha bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti.
an3.120:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇāvācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāvācā paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti.
an3.120:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco anabhijjhālu hoti, avyāpannacitto hoti. sammādiṭṭhiko hoti.
